morgan: quick ping — PR #3227: small internal id casing fix (exported -> Exported). Ran gofmt; CI flagged vet/lint in pkg/runner. PTAL, trying to land before tomorrow's deploy window.

morgan: code snippet:
```
- var exportedErr = errors.New("...")
+ var ExportedErr = errors.New("...")
```

alex: looks fine, does that change any public API? @morgan
cheng: any tests to catch callers? search + replace ok?

morgan: no public API change, internal only. added small unit in runner_test.go to reference ExportedErr.
jeff: quick glance — lgtm, add a changelog? :thumbsup:
sophia: if it's internal no changelog needed IMO, just note in PR description :+1:

ci-bot: [PR 3227] build failed — `go vet` found: exported var "exportedErr" should have comment or be exported as ExportedErr in pkg/runner/ids.go
morgan: ah yep, I missed one file, fixing now.

morgan: pushed fix, force-pushed squashed commits.
ci-bot: re-run triggered — running checks...
ci-bot: [PR 3227] all checks passed ✅
jeff: approved and merging after you squash, @morgan? :shipit:
morgan: already squashed, go ahead.
jeff: merging now. will watch rollout, ping if anything odd.

morgan: thanks all :pray:
